info.swHint1: If the chat view reports a "Could not register service worker" error:
info.swHint2: 1. This is a VS Code platform defect (common on 1.100.x), unrelated to the extension;
info.swHint3: 2. First try: Command Palette → Developer: Reload Window;
info.swHint4: 3. Then try: Help → Check for Updates and upgrade to the latest VS Code;
info.swHint5: 4. Last resort: fully quit VS Code, delete %APPDATA%\Code\Service Worker\CacheStorage and %APPDATA%\Code\Cache\Cache_Data, then restart; if that fails, reinstall VS Code from code.visualstudio.com.
